info.title: sqlxl
info.description: SqlXL is a .NET global tool for SQL Server data professionals. Bulk-insert or bulk-update rows via Excel with full staging-table validation, or export query results to Excel — no web server, no extra infrastructure required.

commands.name: demo
commands.description: Create the SqlXlDemo database with sample data (drops and recreates)

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection
options.description:
SQL Server connection string for the server
that will host SqlXlDemo

options.name: --yes
options.description:
Skip the confirmation prompt and proceed
immediately

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export SQL query results to Excel (requires sqlxl init)

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection
options.description:
SQL Server connection string (overrides saved
profile)

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Named connection profile to use (overrides
active profile)

options.name: --query
options.description:
SELECT statement to export (validated via
SqlXl infrastructure before execution)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output Excel file path (optional; defaults to
export_YYYYMMDD_HHmmss.xlsx)

options.name: --no-launch
options.description:
Do not open the generated Excel file (useful
for agents and scripts)

commands.name: import
commands.description: Generate a template or import data via a custom BulkOpFeature (--feature N)

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection
options.description:
SQL Server connection string (overrides saved
profile)

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Named connection profile to use (overrides
active profile)

options.name: --feature
options.description: BulkOpFeature ID from SqlXl.BulkOpFeatures

options.name: --file
options.description:
Excel file to import. Omit to generate a
template instead

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output path for generated template (optional;
defaults to Feature_YYYYMMDD.xlsx)

options.name: --no-launch
options.description:
Do not open the generated Excel file (useful
for agents and scripts)

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Connect to a SQL Server database, install SqlXL infrastructure, and save the
connection profile

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection
options.description:
SQL Server connection string for the database
to initialize

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Name to save this connection under (default:
"default")

commands.name: insert
commands.description: Generate an INSERT template or import a filled template into a table

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection
options.description:
SQL Server connection string (overrides saved
profile)

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Named connection profile to use (overrides
active profile)

options.name: --table
options.description:
Domain table to target, e.g. dbo.Products or
just Products (assumes dbo)

options.name: --file
options.description:
Excel file to import. Omit to generate an
empty INSERT template instead

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output path for generated template (optional;
defaults to TableName_insert_YYYYMMDD.xlsx)

options.name: --no-launch
options.description:
Do not open the generated Excel file (useful
for agents and scripts)

commands.name: test
commands.description: Auto-generate and run test data against all configured features for a table

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection
options.description:
SQL Server connection string (overrides saved
profile)

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Named connection profile to use (overrides
active profile)

options.name: --table
options.description:
Domain table to test, e.g. dbo.Products or
just Products (assumes dbo)

options.name: --rows
options.description:
Number of test rows to generate per feature
(default: 1, max: 100)

commands.name: update
commands.description:
Generate an UPDATE template pre-populated with existing rows, or import a filled
template

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection
options.description:
SQL Server connection string (overrides saved
profile)

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Named connection profile to use (overrides
active profile)

options.name: --table
options.description:
Domain table to target, e.g. dbo.Products or
just Products (assumes dbo)

options.name: --where
options.description:
SQL WHERE clause to filter rows for the
template, e.g. "CategoryID = 1" (export mode
only)

options.name: --file
options.description:
Excel file to import. Omit to generate a
populated UPDATE template instead

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output path for generated template (optional;
defaults to TableName_update_YYYYMMDD.xlsx)

options.name: --no-launch
options.description:
Do not open the generated Excel file (useful
for agents and scripts)
